content: Premium event-production and exhibition marketing sites for corporate buyers converge on a five-page IA (Home, About, Services, Work/Portfolio, Contact). Showit (Mar 2026) lists portfolio-forward imagery, skimmable services, process/testimonials, multi-placement inquiry CTAs, qualifying forms (date/location/event type), and a homepage that previews work+services+CTA. Live sites confirm: Extraordinary Productions (US) uses Design/Build/Produce services, event-type work, process, logos, form+phone; Spectrum UAE adds quote fields (exhibition name, stand size), WhatsApp widget, testimonials, client logos; Al Safa and Beyond DXB add WhatsApp plus quote forms. Venue-style booking calendars and rental catalogs appear on adjacent verticals, not production-house sites.
